name: Trakzee Mini
description: Simplified GPS vehicle tracking platform designed for agile fleet visibility, trip history, and real-time ignition alerts.
highlights: Real-time GPS vehicle tracking with 10s telemetry updates
Ignition on/off alerts and unauthorized movement notification
Speed monitoring and geofence boundary breach alerts
90-day trip route playback and idle time analytics

name: LogyTrak
description: Advanced transport and logistics management software designed for consignment tracking, route dispatch, and supply chain visibility.
highlights: Real-time consignment tracking with transit milestones and checkpoint alerts
Automated multi-stop route optimization and carrier dispatch management
Electronic Proof of Delivery (e-POD) with OTP and digital signatures
Comprehensive detention, demurrage, and turnaround time analytics

name: Petzee
description: Intelligent pet tracking and safety platform designed to help pet owners monitor real-time location, activity, and safe zones.
highlights: Real-time GPS live location with virtual safe perimeter geofencing
Instant escape alerts when pet leaves home or park boundaries
Daily activity goal tracking, steps, and resting vitals
Waterproof BLE & 4G collar sync with parent mobile app

name: Elexee
description: Smart electric vehicle (EV) fleet management platform to monitor battery state of charge (SOC), charging cycles, and regenerative range.
highlights: Live Battery State of Charge (SOC) and real-time range estimation
Charging station route planning and energy consumption rates
Battery health degradation diagnostics and temperature safeguards
CAN-bus integration for real-time motor and inverter telemetry

name: TaskEye
description: Smart workforce and field task management platform designed to streamline dispatch, proof-of-visit, and team productivity.
highlights: GPS-verified employee attendance and geofenced client check-ins
Real-time task dispatching with in-app photo and digital signature
Automated mileage calculation for field travel reimbursement
Manager live map view showing active technician whereabouts

name: SmartWaste
description: Advanced waste collection system that simplifies municipal cleanup with smart bin level sensors and dynamic truck routing.
highlights: Ultrasonic bin fill-level monitoring with automated fullness threshold alerts
Dynamic AI routing for garbage trucks targeting only full bins
RFID bin pickup verification and driver completion logging
Municipal carbon savings and fuel reduction reporting

name: SmartTranzit
description: Public transportation management software designed to streamline passenger counting, bus scheduling, and route optimization.
highlights: Automated Passenger Counting (APC) sensors via overhead AI cameras
Dynamic bus route scheduling with live passenger arrival displays (PIDS)
Automated fare collection (AFC) validation and ticket integration
Driver schedule adherence and headway management alerts

name: Employee Transportation
description: Enterprise employee commute and shuttle management platform ensuring safe, timely, and automated corporate staff transportation.
highlights: Automated shift rostering and intelligent employee pickup/drop clustering
Real-time cab tracking with employee boarding validation and ETA updates
Women safety protocols including escort guard management and safe drop confirmation
In-app SOS emergency panic button with 24/7 command center escalation

name: SmartBus
description: School transportation management software providing parents and schools with live student tracking, RFID boarding, and instant ETA.
highlights: Live school bus tracking on parent app with push notifications
Student RFID boarding and drop-off confirmation with photo timestamp
Automated pickup & drop route optimization with stop geofencing
Driver rash driving and speeding alerts with emergency SOS panic button

name: Gridzee
description: Real-time indoor location and monitoring system (RTLS) for people, forklifts, and medical or warehouse equipment.
highlights: Sub-meter BLE and Ultra-Wideband (UWB) indoor positioning accuracy
Multi-floor 2.5D building mapping with zone-based access control
Warehouse asset utilization heatmaps and forklift collision alerts
Lone-worker man-down alerts and emergency evacuation muster counts
